<!-- pr-reviewer: 6228e1a7484621089998a283fe24276985278999 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next cut).

Thanks, @mkinney - a thorough piece of work.

**What looks good**
- The two fixes are right. `SpunProfile::bands()` (crates/tools/src/spun.rs) now folds a zero-height step's larger radius into the band ending at that height (else the one starting there), so the collision envelope is never smaller than the drawn outline. `max_radius()` feeds the summary from the same outline the bands read, so tab and check cannot disagree. Arcs flatten conservatively (convex by tangent polygon, concave by chords). Validation refuses degenerate input by name (`SpunError`); no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new non-test code.
- The edit goes through the undoable `SetToolBody` command with `invert`; the component change is in `schema.rs`; ui -> app layering kept. No Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/build.rs/scripts/.github change in the PR itself (the Cargo diffs in the trial merge come from main).
- Provenance line on the new modules; a decisions file is in `docs/decisions/`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; `Changelog:` line present.

**Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main, clean merge, macOS)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| camcraft-tools | 31 + 3 pass |
| app `tool_spun_profile` | 7 pass |
| app `tool_body` / `tool_body_view` | 8 / 8 pass |
| app `turning_holder` | 8 pass |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 69 pass |
| camcraft-ui `--lib tool_` (from crates/ui) | 25 pass, 1 ignored |
| clippy tools/app/ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Release-lane `tool_editor_snapshot` (new tab row) was not run; pixel diffs there are by design.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The body says `Refs #93`, not `Fixes #93`, with follow-ups listed; that is consistent with partial work, so #93 will stay open on merge.
- Several files in the PR are near or over the ~400-line guide in the touched app/ui areas; I did not see a blocking growth.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
